title: Probe Codex --add-dir and writable_roots; mark them unverified until then

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: S87 (landed aa7b1e5) passes --add-dir TEMP on fresh Codex write rounds and -c sandbox_workspace_write.writable_roots=[TEMP, WORKTREE] on resumed ones. docs/design.md:517-523 states both as fact, but no probe in testdata/vendors/codex covers them; the only evidence is the hand-run relay form (S74, S48). Gate later note, owner-recommended option (c): mark unverified now and add a probe.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `docs/design.md:733-741`: the Codex adapter paragraph states --add-dir and writable_roots as fact; cite probes 11 and 12 there (`testdata/vendors/codex/11-fresh-add-dir.*`, `12-resume-writable-roots.*`). Do not mark them unverified: both probes passed.
- `testdata/vendors/codex/`: probes 11 and 12 are already recorded (owner chose "You run it", 2026-10-27; the outer session ran both in a scratch repo). Do not edit them.
- `internal/agent/codex/codex.go`: no change; the probe shows the same flag forms (`--add-dir TEMP` fresh, `-c sandbox_workspace_write.writable_roots=[...]` on resume).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: None to write. The design.md paragraph names probe 11 (fresh --add-dir: temp and worktree writable, the probe repo outside denied with "operation not permitted") and probe 12 (resume with writable_roots: same result), by file name.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Docs only. In the Codex adapter paragraph, after the sentence on --add-dir and after the sentence on writable_roots, add a short clause citing the probe file (like the S89 probe 08 cite). One more sentence: both probes wrote to the temp dir and the worktree, and were denied outside them. Short plain sentences. No other doc changes.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: slicer check; adj lint; go test ./internal/agent/codex if the adapter changes.
